title: Marginal quality utility curve and threshold proposals
content:
- est_unit_cost_variant = (mean_tokens_variant/1000)*cost_per_1k_tokens_variant (formula)
- delta_cost = est_unit_cost_variant - est_unit_cost_baseline
- quality_baseline (number)
- quality_variant (number)
- delta_quality = quality_variant - quality_baseline
- marginal_loss_rate = if(delta_cost < 0, -delta_quality / -delta_cost, null)

Practical formulas to add as spreadsheet helpers
---
- expected_monthly_savings = delta_cost * est_monthly_volume
- risk_adjusted_utility = delta_quality * w_quality + (delta_cost * w_cost)  (we typically use w_quality = 1, w_cost = 0.002 to put dollars on same scale; weights will be tuned)
- gate_pass = marginal_loss_rate < gate_threshold OR (delta_quality > -abs_quality_threshold)

Example rows (CSVish sample)
---
id,route,bucket,baseline_model,variant_model,variant_quant,mean_tokens_baseline,mean_tokens_variant,cost_1k_baseline,cost_1k_variant,quality_baseline,quality_variant
r1,search,short,redwood-7b,redwood-3b,4bit,120,95,0.60,0.35,0.78,0.74
r2,compose,long,redwood-13b,redwood-13b,q4_0,420,420,0.90,0.60,0.86,0.85

Row r1 calculation narrative:
- est_unit_cost_baseline = (120/1000)*0.60 = $0.072
- est_unit_cost_variant = (95/1000)*0.35 = $0.03325
- delta_cost = -$0.03875 saved per call
- delta_quality = -0.04 (4 point drop)
- marginal_loss_rate = 0.04 / 0.03875 = ~1.03 quality-points per $ saved (bad)

Row r2 narrative:
- smaller quality drop for larger batch, delta_cost saved is $0.126 => marginal_loss_rate = 0.01 / 0.126 = 0.079 quality-points per $ saved (good)

Policy proposal (conservative baseline)
---
1) Per-bucket gate thresholds: set a two-parameter gate per (route, bucket):
   - absolute_quality_floor: disallow any variant with quality_variant < absolute_quality_floor
   - marginal_loss_threshold: allow variants where marginal_loss_rate <= X (X to be tuned)
2) Suggested initial defaults:
   - low-risk bucket (low-SL, internal users): marginal_loss_threshold = 0.5 qpnt/$, absolute_quality_floor = baseline_quality - 0.10
   - standard bucket (public, interactive): marginal_loss_threshold = 0.15 qpnt/$, absolute_quality_floor = baseline_quality - 0.05
   - high-SLO bucket (paid features): marginal_loss_threshold = 0.05 qpnt/$, absolute_quality_floor = baseline_quality - 0.02
3) Rollout stages:
   - canary: apply gate only to 5% of traffic, monitor eval and live NPS proxies for 48–72h
   - warm: 20% for 24h
   - broad: 100% if no regression alerts

Simulation checklist and quick experiments
---
- join eval set (per-bucket) to cost runs, compute distribution of marginal_loss_rate instead of mean only
- simulate portfolio impact: take histogram of calls by bucket, compute net monthly savings vs. expected aggregate quality loss (weighted by traffic)
- test sensitivity to token-length drift: re-run computations with +10% token assumption for variant (to catch regressions where cache misses increase tokens)
- run human eval on top-10 worst marginal_loss_rate candidates to verify metric correlates with perceived harm

Open questions / notes to self
---
- How to reconcile composite quality metrics across routes? Propose converting each metric to a z-score relative to baseline and weighting by route-revenue or user-impact to get a shard-agnostic marginal metric.
- Do we want static dollar denominators (1k tokens) or model-specific amortized cost per call (including KV cache hits)? For Dedicated customers the per-call cost should be customer-specific.
- Tie-in with Optimize suggestions: use the optimizer to propose candidate variants ranked by marginal_loss_rate, but enforce gate by bucket in Console.

Operationalization steps (engineering / product)
---
- sheet -> canonical CSV export job: optimize-cost-evals/{date}/marginal-utility.csv
- implement gating microservice (stateless): input = route, bucket, candidate_variant, output = pass/fail + reason + estimated_savings. It will use the canonical CSV as backing store and a small TTL cache.
- Console UI: show marginal curve plot for a selected route/bucket, with dotted lines for current thresholds and tooltips showing sample rows.
- Alerting: create alert when only high-marginal-rate variants remain for >72h (indicating we are out of cheap good variants)

Immediate next experiments (2 week scope)
---
- populate sheet for 8 representative routes: search-short, search-long, compose-short, compose-long, assistant-chat, extraction, re-rank, embeddings-heavy. (Owners: Aisha / Benji)
- run batch cost measurement job for top 5 candidate variants per route (owner: infra/benchmarks)
- human eval on the 20 worst marginal_loss_rate pairs (owner: product-research)
- tune initial thresholds using a Pareto frontier visual inspection session with eng+product (owner: Marisol)

Unresolved decisions for the priorities doc
---
- whether to incorporate user-level measures (e.g., conversation abandonment) as a multiplier on delta_quality
- how to version gates and expose historical snapshots in Console for audit (we should store gate config in a small JSONL versioned store)
